revision_policy: Any glyph scoring below 3/5 agreement is replaced by its revised specification. Passing glyph specifications are preserved from the supplied source set.

glyphs.static_form: Square peg overlapping round hole: 16px square slot outline left, hexagonal peg right overlapping with 2px gap + central X. Grid-aligned, high-contrast stroke 2px.
glyphs.motion: Peg attempts insertion on loop: translate 4px left with elastic out, collides, jitter 3x at 60ms, bounce back 4px. 1.8s loop, easeOutElastic on bounce. Trigger on validation fail.
glyphs.color_logic: Amber #FFA500 for mismatch, desaturated grey for slot. Hue does not encode severity; opacity of X encodes mismatch degree.
glyphs.variable_params: jitter count ~ retry attempts, gap width ~ schema divergence score, X opacity ~ validation error count

glyphs.static_form: Tool glyph (wrench 45deg) inside dotted 24px circle with centered 2-bar pause icon (||) overlay. Dotted circle = waiting container.
glyphs.motion: Static hold with pause bars breathing opacity 0.35->1.0 sine in-out 1.2s loop. No rotation. Dots static.
glyphs.color_logic: Desaturated slate-blue #6B7B8F = idle wait. No hue scale.
glyphs.variable_params: breath period ~ elapsed wait time (slows as wait lengthens), opacity floor ~ expected remaining time

glyphs.static_form: Two stacked memory layers (3 horizontal bars each) overlapping at 30deg offset, central collision diamond with !. Overlap region hatched.
glyphs.motion: Layers push toward center 2px then recoil 0.15s alternating, collision diamond flashes 200ms on contact. 1.5s loop.
glyphs.color_logic: Dual-tone: teal #2EB5A5 vs magenta #D6457C for conflicting traces, yellow flash on conflict zone.
glyphs.variable_params: recoil amplitude ~ conflict strength, flash frequency ~ number of conflicting memories, hatch density ~ overlap size

glyphs.static_form: Dashed rounded rectangle (task card) with missing bottom edge, central ? formed by dotted pixels, 3 corner anchors present 1 missing.
glyphs.motion: Dotted ? flickers random pixels, dashed border marches slowly clockwise (marching ants 2s). Missing edge pulses outline.
glyphs.color_logic: Light grey #B0BEC5 dashed = underspecified, amber ? = need clarification.
glyphs.variable_params: dash speed ~ ambiguity score, ? flicker rate ~ number of underspecified parameters, gap length ~ spec completeness %

glyphs.static_form: Balance scale with two document icons on pans tilted 15deg, documents have opposing arrows (↑ vs ↓), central crack line.
glyphs.motion: Scale tips left-right 0.8s seesaw easeInOut, documents vibrate, crack glows on extreme tilt. Loop 2s.
glyphs.color_logic: Neutral grey scale, documents: cyan vs orange for opposing evidence. Red crack intensity = conflict severity.
glyphs.variable_params: tilt angle ~ weight delta, vibration amplitude ~ evidence contradiction strength, crack glow ~ confidence in conflict detection

glyphs.static_form: Wrench inside 270deg C-shaped progress ring with 90deg gap at top, 4 tick marks on circumference.
glyphs.motion: Ring rotates clockwise continuous linear 1s/rev, gap acts as spinner. Ticks pass fixed indicator. Stutters if polling blocked.
glyphs.color_logic: Active cyan #00B8D4 = actively waiting/polling.
glyphs.variable_params: rotation speed ~ polling frequency, ring thickness ~ wait priority, stutter duration ~ backoff interval

glyphs.static_form: Polyline path with 3 nodes (circle-square-circle) + eraser icon erasing middle segment with dashed revised segment branching off at 30deg.
glyphs.motion: Eraser scrubs middle segment 300ms, old segment fades to dotted, new dashed segment draws in left-to-right 600ms easeOutQuad. Loop 2.5s with pause.
glyphs.color_logic: Grey #9E9E9E old path, electric blue #2979FF new path, pink eraser.
glyphs.variable_params: scrub speed ~ revision magnitude, new path length ~ plan delta, node pulse ~ revision depth

glyphs.static_form: Horizontal timeline with 4 ticks, current marker at tick 4, curved U-arrow from tick 4 back to tick 2 checkpoint (flag).
glyphs.motion: Marker jumps back along arrow with motion blur, timeline flashes at target checkpoint 150ms, arrow draws backward 400ms easeInCubic. Loop 2s hold.
glyphs.color_logic: Amber #FFAB00 for rollback arrow, grey timeline, green flag checkpoint.
glyphs.variable_params: arrow arc height ~ rollback distance (ticks), flash intensity ~ state loss severity, animation duration ~ rollback cost

glyphs.static_form: 24px knowledge lattice containing six fixed information cells arranged 3x2. Five cells are solid and connected; one required cell is an unmistakable empty outlined socket. A short inbound dependency line terminates at the empty socket without connecting. The missing location, not general incompleteness, is the dominant geometry.
glyphs.motion: Dependency pulse travels through connected cells, reaches the empty socket, and halts. The empty socket emits one expanding outline pulse, then the dependency pulse resets. 1.8s loop. No random motion.
glyphs.color_logic: Known cells use neutral cool grey. The missing socket uses amber #FFA500 plus an unfilled interior and dashed inbound termination. Color is redundant; absence and disconnected topology encode the state.
glyphs.variable_params: empty_socket_count ~ number of unresolved required facts; socket_area ~ importance of missing information; inbound_line_count ~ dependent operations blocked by the gap; pulse_frequency ~ urgency of information request

glyphs.static_form: Vertical fuel gauge / battery with 5 segments, all empty outlined, bottom segment red, top $/token icon with 0, diagonal slash across.
glyphs.motion: Needle/level drops from full to empty in 800ms easeInExpo then shakes at empty 100ms. Slash draws diagonally. Hold empty 1s.
glyphs.color_logic: Green->yellow->red gradient by level; final state solid red #D32F2F = exhausted, grey empty segments.
glyphs.variable_params: drop speed ~ burn rate, shake amplitude ~ over-budget amount, segment count ~ budget type (tokens/calls/time)

glyphs.static_form: Outer dashed cube (isometric) containing inner solid cube with execution play-triangle inside. Outer cube has lock icons on corners.
glyphs.motion: Inner cube gently floats/bobs 6px vertical sine 2s, outer cube border pulses containment field 1.5s, no escape. Containment shimmer on edges.
glyphs.color_logic: Outer sandbox amber dashed #FF8F00 = containment, inner execution cyan #00ACC1 = active but confined.
glyphs.variable_params: bob amplitude ~ execution activity, border pulse rate ~ sandbox strictness level, lock count ~ permission restrictiveness

glyphs.static_form: Forward arrow that loops into U-turn with eraser tail, small checkmark at new direction, ghost of old arrow faint behind.
glyphs.motion: Arrow moves forward 200ms, pauses, draws U-turn 400ms easeInOutBack, eraser wipes ghost trail 300ms. Loop 2.2s.
glyphs.color_logic: Grey ghost = prior error, teal #009688 corrected path, green check = correction validated.
glyphs.variable_params: U-turn curvature ~ correction magnitude, wipe speed ~ confidence in correction, check scale ~ verification strength

glyphs.static_form: Syringe/injection arrow piercing document/shield shape, overlay warning triangle with ! at injection point, biohazard-like pixels around entry.
glyphs.motion: Syringe pulses inward 2px 3x rapid 150ms then warning triangle flashes red 200ms on/off. Loop 1.6s. Trigger on input parse.
glyphs.color_logic: Syringe neon green #76FF03 = external content, warning red #FF1744 = suspect, shield grey.
glyphs.variable_params: pulse count ~ injection confidence score, triangle flash rate ~ severity, pixel spread ~ taint propagation risk

glyphs.static_form: Clock face with 3 hands frozen at 10:10, overlay dust particles and cobweb corners, calendar page curl with faded text.
glyphs.motion: Clock ticks attempt to move then snaps back 50ms jitter every 1.5s, dust particles drift slowly down 3s linear, no progress.
glyphs.color_logic: Sepia/desaturated #8D6E63 = stale/aged, dust grey #BCAAA4, frozen hands dark.
glyphs.variable_params: jitter frequency ~ staleness duration, dust density ~ time since last refresh, fade amount ~ TTL exceeded %

glyphs.static_form: Horizontal execution rail from start node to terminal node. Completed section is solid, remaining section is dotted, and the transition point contains a perpendicular pause-cap composed of two short bars. The terminal node remains visibly hollow.
glyphs.motion: Progress pulse advances along the completed rail, stops exactly at the pause-cap, compresses slightly against it, and remains stationary for 600ms before resetting. It never enters the unfinished dotted segment.
glyphs.color_logic: Completed path uses teal #20C7C7, unfinished path uses desaturated grey, pause-cap uses amber #FFA500. Geometry independently communicates completed, paused, and remaining portions.
glyphs.variable_params: rail_fill_ratio ~ completed fraction; pause_cap_position ~ interruption point; dotted_length ~ work remaining; pause_duration ~ elapsed stalled time

glyphs.static_form: Speedometer semicircle with needle at 85% mark, red limit line at 80%, throttle bars stacked vertically to right (3 bars).
glyphs.motion: Needle vibrates against limit line 50ms buzz, throttle bars sequentially light up then dim 600ms cascade. Loop 1.4s.
glyphs.color_logic: Green zone < limit, red #E53935 beyond limit line, amber buzz zone.
glyphs.variable_params: needle vibration amplitude ~ request rate / limit ratio, bar count illuminated ~ remaining quota, buzz frequency ~ retry-after time

glyphs.static_form: Circular arrow loop (270deg) with centered dot and small counter badge 'xN' at bottom-right, arrowhead gap at top.
glyphs.motion: Arrow spins 360deg clockwise 700ms easeInOutCubic, pauses, counter increments tick animation (scale pop 150ms). Loop 1.5s. Triggers per retry.
glyphs.color_logic: Retry blue #1E88E5 loop, counter badge orange #FB8C00 = attempt count.
glyphs.variable_params: spin speed ~ retry interval (faster = aggressive), counter value = attempt number, pop scale ~ backoff exponent

glyphs.static_form: Single central node (hexagon) with 5 outward rays to leaf nodes (dots) forming fan/tree, lines thin to thick outward.
glyphs.motion: Central node pulses 200ms then leaves light up sequentially outward 80ms stagger (wave propagation). Lines draw outward 400ms. Loop 1.8s.
glyphs.color_logic: Parent indigo #3949AB, leaves teal #00BFA5, lines gradient parent->leaf.
glyphs.variable_params: leaf count ~ fanout degree, stagger delay ~ delegation latency, pulse scale ~ payload size

glyphs.static_form: Human silhouette icon behind vertical gate/bars, gate has lock with keyhole, hand icon reaching but blocked by gate line.
glyphs.motion: Gate bars slide closed 300ms easeOut, lock clicks shut (scale 1.2 then back 100ms), hand icon bumps gate 2x with recoil. Loop 2s hold closed.
glyphs.color_logic: Human warm grey #795548, gate steel blue #546E7A, lock red #C62828 = blocked, green when granted (not shown).
glyphs.variable_params: gate bar opacity ~ permission strictness, bump recoil ~ urgency, lock size ~ approval authority level

glyphs.static_form: Wrench icon snapped in two with jagged crack gap 3px, overlaid bold X in circle, small sparks at break point.
glyphs.motion: Wrench attempts to turn 15deg then snaps back with crack flash 100ms, X pops in scale 0->1 easeOutBack, sparks emit once. Loop 1.6s.
glyphs.color_logic: Tool steel grey #78909C, crack/sparks orange #FF6D00, failure X red #D50000.
glyphs.variable_params: crack gap width ~ failure severity, spark count ~ error cascade size, X scale ~ terminal vs recoverable

glyphs.static_form: Wrench icon above hourglass with sand, hourglass frame encloses wrench shadow, dotted baseline.
glyphs.motion: Sand trickles top->bottom continuous 1.5s linear, wrench gently bobs 4px sine 1.5s, hourglass flip not triggered until resolved.
glyphs.color_logic: Waiting amber #FFB300 sand, tool grey desaturated 50% = suspended.
glyphs.variable_params: sand flow rate ~ expected wait duration (slow = long), bob amplitude ~ polling vs idle await, sand level ~ time elapsed

glyphs.static_form: Thought bubble / brain outline floating above dashed ground line with gap, tether line cut/dangling, small ? inside bubble.
glyphs.motion: Bubble floats up/down 8px sine 2s with slight drift, tether sways, ground dashed line flickers. No grounding snap.
glyphs.color_logic: Bubble light blue #81D4FA = ungrounded claim, ground grey dashed = missing grounding, ? amber.
glyphs.variable_params: float height ~ ungrounded degree, tether sway ~ hallucination risk, flicker rate ~ evidence absence confidence

glyphs.static_form: Circular rewind symbol: 2 left-pointing triangles with curved arrow looping back to earlier checkpoint dot on circular timeline.
glyphs.motion: Rewind arrow draws counter-clockwise 500ms, triangles blink sequentially, checkpoint dot pings outward ripple. Loop 2s. Duplicate variant for redundancy signaling.
glyphs.color_logic: Rewind amber #FF8F00, timeline grey #BDBDBD, checkpoint green #43A047.
glyphs.variable_params: arrow thickness ~ data loss volume, ripple count ~ rollback depth, blink speed ~ urgency

glyphs.static_form: Two opposing bracket walls [ ] closing in on central block, block squeezed with stress lines, X at contact points.
glyphs.motion: Brackets push inward 4px 300ms easeIn, block compresses 10% then pushes back, stress lines flash. Loop 1.4s.
glyphs.color_logic: Brackets red #E53935 vs blue #1E88E5 = conflicting constraints, block grey, stress yellow.
glyphs.variable_params: compression % ~ conflict irreconcilability, push force ~ constraint priority, flash intensity ~ violation severity

glyphs.static_form: Forward arrow stamped into block with ink stamp border, lock icon over tail, checkmark seal at tip.
glyphs.motion: Stamp slams down 150ms easeInExpo with impact shake 80ms, ink spreads outward, lock clicks shut. One-shot then hold (no loop).
glyphs.color_logic: Committed ink indigo #283593, lock bronze #6D4C41 = irreversible, seal green #2E7D32.
glyphs.variable_params: impact shake ~ commitment cost, ink spread ~ scope of commitment, lock opacity ~ reversibility (0=irreversible)

glyphs.static_form: Wrench overlaid with speedometer limiter: wrench behind vertical throttle bar with 3 segments, top segment red capped, clock icon small.
glyphs.motion: Throttle bar fills then hits cap and bounces 100ms, wrench greys out and pulses dim 500ms, clock ticks. Loop 1.6s.
glyphs.color_logic: Wrench greyed #90A4AE when limited, bar green->red at cap #EF5350, clock amber.
glyphs.variable_params: bar fill % ~ quota used, bounce amplitude ~ rate excess, dim pulse period ~ retry-after window

glyphs.static_form: Bullseye target with center dot (goal) and dotted arrow path that curves away from center, small boat/arrowhead drifting off-axis.
glyphs.motion: Arrowhead slowly drifts off-center 6px over 2s easeInQuad, path trail fades behind, target pulses weakly. Loop with reset.
glyphs.color_logic: Target concentric teal #009688, drift path amber dashed #FFA000 = divergence, arrowhead red when far.
glyphs.variable_params: drift distance ~ goal divergence score, curve angle ~ drift direction, target pulse ~ drift detection confidence

glyphs.static_form: Timeline with flag checkpoint at mid-point, current position marker at end, U-shaped arrow with checkpoint diamond at elbow returning to flag.
glyphs.motion: Marker rewinds along U-arrow 600ms easeInOut, flag waves 200ms on arrival, diamond checkpoint glows. Loop 2.4s.
glyphs.color_logic: Timeline slate #607D8B, flag/checkpoint green #00C853 = safe restore point, rewind arrow blue #2962FF.
glyphs.variable_params: rewind distance ~ checkpoint age, flag wave amplitude ~ checkpoint freshness, glow duration ~ restore cost

glyphs.static_form: Vertical container/bar with stacked text lines inside, pressure lid on top with gauge, lines compressed at top, overflow indicator at brim.
glyphs.motion: Lines compress upward 4px and jitter 60ms, gauge needle rises 500ms, container walls bulge 2% sine 1s. Loop 1.8s.
glyphs.color_logic: Container grey #CFD8DC, gauge green->yellow->red by pressure, overflow red flash at 100%.
glyphs.variable_params: compression density ~ token/context fill %, bulge amount ~ pressure level, needle angle ~ proximity to limit, jitter ~ truncation risk
